entry.author: RNZ
entry.summary:
Two refurbished tanks at Northland’s Marsden Point are officially in use | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1 
 
Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, Finance Minister Nicola Willis and Associate Energy Minister Shane Jones joined Channel Infrastructure chief executive Rob Buchanan on Tuesday to officially mark the completion and recommissioning of the tanks.
 
It has been about three months since senior ministers signed off on the $21.6 million project to refurbish enough capacity at its Marsden Point site to store an additional 93 million litres of diesel.
 
More politics coverage: https://www.rnz.co.nz/news/political
